targets.rawSql: WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS failing FROM scans s JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true

WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target, metric_name) target, metric_name, value_num FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, metric_name, time DESC) SELECT SUM(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'rules_passed') * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'rules_total'), 0) AS pct FROM last
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT target) AS targets FROM scans WHERE created_at > NOW() - interval '5 minutes'

WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target, metric_name) target, metric_name, value_num FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, metric_name, time DESC) SELECT SUM(value_num) AS total FROM last WHERE metric_name = 'rules_total'

SELECT date_trunc('minute', time) AS time, target || ' / ' || CASE metric_name WHEN 'rules_passed' THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS metric, MAX(value_num) AS value FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name IN ('rules_passed', 'rules_failed') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT s.target, r.name AS rule_name, r.description AS rule_description, r.level AS severity, COUNT(*) AS instances FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true GROUP BY s.target, r.name, r.description, r.level ORDER BY r.level DESC NULLS LAST, instances DESC LIMIT 25
